paper.title: Recessions, Mortality, and Migration Bias: Evidence from the Lancashire Cotton Famine

claims.claim: Abstract and article text report the historical population shock and mortality totals, rates, and percentages (including 24,418 excess deaths; 9.5%; 10,191 aged 55+; 18.8%).
Table 1 reports eight summary statistics (each mean, standard deviation, minimum, maximum, and observation count).
Table 2 reports coefficients, standard errors, observations, R-squared values, and permutation p-values.
Table 3 reports age-specific coefficients, standard errors, observations, R-squared values, linked-death counts, and permutation p-values.
Table 4 reports sector coefficients, standard errors, observations, and R-squared values.
Table 5 reports the aggregate, death-location-linked, and enumeration-location-linked coefficients, standard errors, and coefficient-comparison p-values.

results.quantity: reported data-derived numerical results in abstract/main text
results.reported: Multiple values; see cited passages in certificate.md
results.note: The full paper contains many additional numerical statements and tables. The complete shipped pipeline was not translated and executed, so none of its data-derived printed values can be checked from this partial stage.
Table 1 consumes the prepared district-period regression dataset; the downstream preparation and table code were not completed.
The full regression and 538-placebo permutation code were not translated and run.
Age-specific regressions and permutation code were not translated and run.
Occupation-bin preparation and two-way clustered regressions were not translated and run.
Three regression variants and coefficient-equality tests were not translated and run.

findings.description: The reproduction attempt did not execute the complete analysis pipeline. Only the shipped age-weight preparation stage was translated and executed.
findings.evidence: logs/run-01.log records successful creation of 28 age-category/period weights; no downstream tables, regressions, or figures were run.
findings.suggested_fix: Complete a command-by-command translation of all shipped Stata preparation and analysis scripts and run the resulting pipeline.

findings.description: The master Stata script uses a USERPATH placeholder and expects transient Data/_Temp outputs; the original Stata software is absent.
findings.evidence: Analysis/01_Master_Analysis_File.do specifies USERPATH and staged _Temp products; Stata executable not installed.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate and run all preparation scripts in R, preserving the supplied datasets and specifications.

limitations: This is an incomplete reproduction check. The user requested a full command-by-command translation; this deliverable does not satisfy that scope.
The age-weight translation produced an intermediate file only; it does not correspond to a printed result in the article.
Claims are grouped by exhibit rather than enumerated one result per printed number. A complete claim-level inventory remains outstanding.
